purpose: Owner-run receipt: the real .lnk path (Windows PowerShell 5.1, -WindowStyle Hidden) writes logs/launcher/launcher.log in UTF-8 with each Persian progress line once, for exactly one start action.
shell_version_note: Windows PowerShell 5.1 -- the binary AHOS.lnk targets

log.note: The log is append-only across runs; this receipt captures only the segment this start produced so no earlier run is claimed.
